_comment: ⚠️ `firebase init` OVERWRITES this file and drops everything below `public`.
If it has been re-run, check these three are still here before deploying.
cleanUrls is not cosmetic: without it /project returns the 404 page, because
Firebase does not try <path>.html on its own and the project page is a static
project.html. The rewrite goes to 404.html rather than index.html so a typo'd
URL does not silently render the projects list with a 200.
